raw_segments.text: Beatrice, the fault will be in the music, cousin, if you be not wooed in good time.
If the prince be too important, tell him there is measure in everything and so dance out
For hear me, hero, wooing, wedding, and repenting is as a scotch jig, a measure, and a syncopase.
The first suit is hot and hasty, like a scotch jig, and full as fantastical.
The wedding, mannerly modest, as a measure, full of state and ancientry.
And then comes repentance, and with his bad legs, falls into the syncopase faster and
faster till he sink into his grave.
